result.description: Platform for creators to sell digital products, memberships and subscriptions directly to customers.
result.auth_detail: OAuth2 authorization-code flow (token exchange at gumroad.com/oauth/token) for registered apps acting on other users' accounts; personal access token generated in Settings > Advanced for own account. Token sent as Bearer header; non-expiring until revoked.
result.access_detail: Any Gumroad account can create an application in Settings > Advanced and generate an access token; no plan or approval gate found. Gumroad's own docs pages are JS-rendered and could not be fetched directly, so this rests on the MCP README and search-result summaries of the docs.
result.api_notes: REST v2 at api.gumroad.com/v2. Core objects (from knowledge, not verified on page): products, variant categories/variants, offer codes, custom fields, sales, subscribers, licenses (verify/enable/disable), resource subscriptions (webhooks), user. Roughly 30-40 endpoints, no payouts or broad admin surface.
